messages:
maya: Heads-up: Product approved a compatibility "ribbon" approach instead of removing v1 immediately. We need a tiny compat-shim page + ribbon copy, redirects for old doc paths, and two SDK snippet fixes (JS param rename + Go auth whitespace). Target staging next week.

leo: Ribbon copy idea: short, non-alarmist. Draft: \"Planned deprecation: v1 API. See migration steps to v2 (no immediate impact).\" CTA -> /docs/v2/migrate. Keep under 120 chars.

priya: i'll do ribbon strings and add fr/es translations. Also will add small aria-label for accessibility.

sam: i'll own the compat-shim page that explains what the shim does (aliasing, model swap behavior, small examples) and a section "When you'll see redirects". Will keep it <600 words.

maya: two quick SDK items: 1) JS param rename: `completion_options` -> `generate_opts` causes sample code to error in client libs; add a migration table and short JS snippet. 2) Go auth: some users saw token rejections when header contains extra whitespace. Add a short Go snippet showing TrimSpace.

leo: JS snippet suggestion (to add under /docs/v2/migrate#js):
```js
// v1 -> v2 param rename
// old
const resp = await client.completions.create({ model: 'gpt-mini', completion_options: { max_tokens: 100 } })
// new
const resp = await client.generate.create({ model: 'gpt-mini', generate_opts: { max_tokens: 100 } })
```

priya: will include a one-liner note: "If your tests fail after rename, search codebase for `completion_options` and replace with `generate_opts`."

sam: for redirects ops wants an example rule and an analytics tag to track: propose `sunset=v1`. nginx example:
```nginx
# staging: temporary 302 with telemetry param
location ~ ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ {
  return 302 /docs/v2/compat/$1?sunset=v1;
}
```

maya: ops asked we start with a 2% canary (staging) then 20% then 100%. Also add a rollback toggle to remove the redirect quickly.

docs-ci-bot: Suggestion: add a docs-snippet GH Action job that runs JS/Go/Python snippets against a mock server and fails the PR with annotations for failing code blocks. See template in repo-ci/docs-actions.

leo: good. let's make the snippet CI also assert shape (choices array or embeddings vector) and detect legacy param `completion_options` automatically. If found, fail with a hint to change to `generate_opts`.

priya: i'll open PR for ribbon + translations + compat-shim page. adding a tiny section "SDK gotchas" with the JS and Go snippets. PR will include a checklist for ops and CI.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-6022: staged-compat-redirect-canary (2% -> 20% -> 100%). Assigned to sam. ETA staging deploy 2026-04-09.

sam: i'll add the nginx rule to the staging router and run a quick smoke: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" "https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/v1/guides/quickstart" -L` should end in `/docs/v2/compat/guides/quickstart?sunset=v1` with 302 on staging. Add that curl to PR description.

priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6219  ribbon + compat-shim + i18n + SDK-gotchas. I'll add the GH Action job in a follow-up PR to keep reviews small.

maya: awesome. @leo can you add the JS snippet test to the docs-ci runner so PRs flag legacy param use?

leo: yes, will send a small patch to docs-ci next. ETA Monday.

docs-ci-bot: PRs referenced: #6219 (ribbon/compat-shim). Recommend follow-up: #6220 (snippet-ci checks) before we flip to 302 in prod.

maya: timeline recap: PR for ribbon merged -> ops stage 2% canary -> monitor `sunset=v1` hits + error rates -> expand to 20% -> full. If no regressions after 14 days, switch redirects to 301 and remove ribbon. Keep this thread updated with PR/OPS links and canary metrics.

priya: merged localization PR. will post the final banner strings here.

sam: staging router updated under OPS-6022; running smoke now. will post results in 15m.

maya: thanks all. small note for docs: add a short "Developer FAQ" on the shim page: "Will my pinned model ids change?" Answer: "No; pins are preserved but we recommend pinning to revisions for long-term stability." Add that to PR if possible.

priya: added FAQ line in PR #6219. closing loop for my part. :white_check_mark:
